<canvas id="particles-canvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>

<script>
// ======= Dominique's Particles (no libs) =======
(() => {
  const cv = document.getElementById('particles-canvas');
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');

  const CONFIG = {
    colors: ['#70d6ff', '#4c9df1', '#2445ec'],
    speed: 0.6,
    linkDist: 120,
    linkAlpha: 0.16,
    sizeMin: 1,
    sizeMax: 2.4,
    maxCount: 180,
    densityDesktop: 12000,
    densityMobile: 7000,
    dprCap: 2
  };

  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let running = !reduce.matches;
  reduce.addEventListener?.('change', e => {
    running = !e.matches;
    if (running) animate();
  });

  let W=0, H=0, DPR=1, P=[];
  function rand(a,b){ return a + Math.random()*(b-a); }
  function pick(arr){ return arr[(Math.random()*arr.length)|0]; }

  function resize(){
    DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, CONFIG.dprCap);
    W = cv.clientWidth = window.innerWidth;
    H = cv.clientHeight = window.innerHeight;
    cv.width  = Math.floor(W * DPR);
    cv.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    initParticles();
  }

  function countForArea(){
    const area = W * H;
    const dense = matchMedia('(max-width: 600px)').matches ?
                  CONFIG.densityMobile : CONFIG.densityDesktop;
    return Math.min(CONFIG.maxCount, Math.max(30, Math.floor(area / dense)));
  }

  function initParticles(){
    const n = countForArea();
    P = new Array(n).fill(0).map(() => ({
      x: Math.random()*W,
      y: Math.random()*H,
      vx: rand(-CONFIG.speed, CONFIG.speed),
      vy: rand(-CONFIG.speed, CONFIG.speed),
      r: rand(CONFIG.sizeMin, CONFIG.sizeMax),
      c: pick(CONFIG.colors)
    }));
  }

  function step(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    for(const p of P){
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;

      if (p.x < 0 || p.x > W) p.vx *= -1;
      if (p.y < 0 || p.y > H) p.vy *= -1;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
      ctx.fill();
    }

    for(let i=0;i<P.length;i++){
      for(let j=i+1;j<P.length;j++){
        const a = P[i], b = P[j];
        const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
        const d2 = dx*dx + dy*dy;
        const md = CONFIG.linkDist;
        if (d2 < md*md){
          const alpha = CONFIG.linkAlpha * (1 - Math.sqrt(d2)/md);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
          ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(112,214,255,${alpha.toFixed(3)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function animate(){
    if (!running) return;
    step();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', resize, { passive: true });

  resize();
  if (running) animate();
})();
</script>
